title: new family members join me at my secluded forest home - springtime blessings
en: foreign there is still quite a bit of snow on the ground despite the first days of spring that I can sense my little Valley is starting to wake up after five sleepy months of snow and ice the warmth in the air couldn't be more welcomed and despite the mud on my boots I'm in High Spirits and anticipating the first spring flowers I still have a while to wait but the new season is moving in the air has shifted smells of fresh soil and saplings permeate the forest
foreign thank you this is a time of great change in my

quiet secluded life I have great plans of future gardening projects hiking on Trails newly uncovered and as promised the announcement of some new additions to my animal family wood was full of rabbit holes and in the neatest sandiest told the ball lived Benjamin's aunt and his cousins flopsy mopsy Cottontail and Peter old Mrs rabbit was a widow she earned her living by knitting rabbit wool mittens and muffets I once bought a pair at a Bazaar

she also sold herbs and rosemary tea and rabbit tobacco which is what we call lavender foreign Bernard two sweet little rabbits that have recently found their way into my life once they're old enough they will be living together in a little rabbit dwelling my husband and I are building in the spring in the meantime they're getting used to all the new smells and sounds of the cottage safely tucked away in a little indoor Hutch they're already bringing me great joy adding a new vibrancy into my cold and snowy world I recently decided to make a little

porch Garden of herbs and flowers and a vegetable garden in front of my home with great plans to grow more mint and chamomile for tea I used to dislike this time of year somewhere between winter and spring when all you see is mud and dead grass mixed in with melting snow and yet now I like to see it as a necessary time as we all must accept seasons of scarcity in order to truly enjoy the abundance that is yet to come cloudy and dark days are perhaps not so bad as we think because they always give way to something beautiful if we are only patient foreign I think I still have mud on me it is so

swampy and wet outside but I have to admit I'm really enjoying it because I am so ready for spring it's been I think almost five months of snow and that is a much longer winter than we're used to and so I just I just I'm impatient but I'm trying to be patient so yes we did invite two lovely new bunnies to come live with us Luke and I are gonna work on building a wonderful outdoor Sanctuary for them for the spring and if you happen to know where the names Bianca and Bernard come from do let me know it is one of my favorite sets of movies so of course there is a lot of change on the horizon change of seasons

new bunnies new things to build around the house sales from my Etsy shop this week will be helping go towards building Bernard and Bianca's new outdoor Sanctuary hopefully it can be a place to bring rescued rabbits in the future as well and so I have big plans rabbits have always been one of my favorite types of animals I think that they are so sweet and so deeply affected by their environment if they're in a chaotic and Loud environment it is quite difficult for them to thrive and they really crave peace and nature and quietness and I feel like our souls are quite similar in that way so I'm a huge fan of bunnies

and I'm so happy to have more in my life if flowers are blooming and things are bright and blue where you are that is so wonderful please send some of that lovely warmth and Magic over here but the snow will be melted soon I am sure sending all my love I will see you very soon thank you foreign
zh: 外国的，尽管春天的第一天，我能感觉到我的小山谷在经历了五个月的冰雪沉睡后开始苏醒，空气中的温暖是再好不过了，尽管我的靴子上沾满了泥土，但我还是兴高采烈，期待着春天的第一朵花，我还有一段时间等待，但新的季节正在空气中移动，新鲜土壤的气味已经改变，树苗弥漫在森林里
外国人谢谢你这是我发生巨大变化的时刻
安静的隐居生活 我对未来的园艺项目有一个伟大的计划 在新发现的小路上徒步旅行，正如所承诺的，我的动物家族的一些新成员的宣布 树林里充满了兔子洞，在最整洁的沙子里，告诉舞会住着本杰明的姨妈和他的表兄弟，软绵绵的棉尾和彼得 老兔子夫人是一个寡妇，她靠编织兔毛手套和手笼来谋生，我曾经在集市上买了一双
门廊 香草和鲜花花园，以及我家门前的菜园，计划种植更多薄荷和洋甘菊来泡茶，我以前不喜欢每年冬天和春天之间的这个时候，你所看到的只是泥土和死草，与融化的雪混合在一起，但现在我喜欢把它视为一个必要的时间，因为我们都必须接受匮乏的季节，以便真正享受即将到来的丰收 阴天和黑暗的日子也许并不像我们想象的那么糟糕，因为如果我们愿意的话，它们总是让位于美丽的东西唯一有耐心的外国人 我想我身上还有泥土，就是这样

外面又湿又湿，但我不得不承认我真的很喜欢它，因为我已经为春天做好了准备，我想已经下了将近五个月的雪了，这是一个比我们习惯的冬天更长的冬天，所以我只是我只是我很不耐烦，但我试图保持耐心，所以是的，我们确实邀请了两只可爱的新兔子来和我们一起住，卢克和我将在春天为它们建造一个美妙的户外避难所，如果你碰巧知道比安卡和比安卡的名字在哪里的话伯纳德来自请让我知道这是我最喜欢的电影之一，所以当然季节变化会发生很多变化
本周我的 Etsy 商店销售的新兔子新东西将有助于建造伯纳德和比安卡的新户外庇护所，希望它将来也能成为一个带来获救兔子的地方，所以我有一个宏伟的计划兔子一直是我最喜欢的动物类型之一，我认为它们是如此可爱，并且深受环境影响，如果它们处于混乱和喧闹的环境中，它们很难茁壮成长，它们真的渴望和平和自然和安静，我觉得我们的灵魂在这方面很相似，所以我是兔子的超级粉丝
我很高兴能在我的生活中拥有更多，如果鲜花盛开，一切都明亮而蓝色，你在的地方，那真是太棒了，请送一些可爱的温暖和魔法到这里，但雪很快就会融化，我相信送出我所有的爱，我很快就会见到你，谢谢你外国人
